body:
Filing an appeal before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) under the Faceless Appeal Scheme requires crisp legal structuring.

Formulation Strategy for Form 35:
1. Grounds of Appeal: Draft clear, un-convoluted questions of law and fact without combining multiple additions.
2. Statement of Facts: Chronologically detail the scrutiny background, assessing officer errors, and evidence overlooked.
3. Additional Evidence under Rule 46A: File applications explicitly proving why records could not be produced during original assessment.

All submissions must be submitted digitally via the e-Filing portal within the 30-day statutory timeline.
title: Faceless Appeals before CIT(A): Drafting Form 35 Grounds and Statement of Facts
summary: Strategic formulation of grounds of appeal, rebuttal submissions, and video conference advocacy before NFAC.
